sketches.notes: Custom profile L-shape in the XZ plane. IRON RULE 1: sketch local x = world X, sketch local y = world Z. Closed vertex loop: (-25,0) -> (25,0) -> (25,30) -> (20,30) -> (20,5) -> (-25,5) -> back to (-25,0). This is the union of the base arm (world X = -25..+25, Z = 0..5, i.e. BASE_LENGTH_X 50 x THICKNESS_Z 5) and the vertical leg arm (world X = +20..+25, Z = 0..30, i.e. LEG_THICKNESS_X 5 x LEG_TOTAL_HEIGHT_Z 30). Area check: 50*5 + 5*25 = 250 + 125 = 375 mm^2. The single profile is extruded once along Y, so base and leg are one continuous solid (special feature [1], [5], [6], [7]). Plane offset -15 mm along the XZ-plane normal places the section so that the positive extrusion spans world Y = -15..+15 (BASE_WIDTH_Y = 30), centered on the origin.

steps.label: Extrude single L-shaped XZ profile 30 mm along Y
steps.notes: Single continuous extrusion of the closed L-profile along Y. Sketch plane offset -15.0 mm, positive extrusion 30.0 mm => solid spans world Y = -15 to +15 (BASE_WIDTH_Y = 30, centered at Y = 0). Result: base slab occupies X = -25..+25, Y = -15..+15, Z = 0..5; vertical leg occupies X = +20..+25, Y = -15..+15, Z = 0..30 (LEG_OUTER_FACE_X = 25, LEG_INNER_FACE_X = 20, LEG_TOTAL_HEIGHT_Z = 30, LEG_HEIGHT_ABOVE_BASE_Z = 25). One L-shaped solid, not two stacked plates.

steps.label: 6 mm through-hole centered on base footprint
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z, base plate spans Z = 0..5. Hole axis at world (X = 0, Y = 0) = centroid of the 50 x 30 base footprint (HOLE_CENTER_X = 0, HOLE_CENTER_Y = 0). Drill with overshoot on both sides (enter below Z = 0, exit above Z = 5). Clearance check: hole edge at X = HOLE_CENTER_X + HOLE_RADIUS = 0 + 3 = 3 mm, leg inner face at LEG_INNER_FACE_X = 20 mm -> 17 mm clear, hole does NOT intersect the leg (special feature [4]). The leg sits at X = 20..25 so the +Y/-Y leg faces are untouched by the hole.

Area check: 50*5 + 5*25 = 250 + 125 = 375 mm^2. The single profile is extruded once along Y, so base and leg are one continuous solid (special feature [1], [5], [6], [7]). Plane offset -15 mm along the XZ-plane normal places the section so that the positive extrusion spans world Y = -15..+15 (BASE_WIDTH_Y = 30), centered on the origin.

One L-shaped solid, not two stacked plates.

steps.label: 6 mm through-hole centered on base footprint
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z, base plate spans Z = 0..5. Hole axis at world (X = 0, Y = 0) = centroid of the 50 x 30 base footprint (HOLE_CENTER_X = 0, HOLE_CENTER_Y = 0). Clearance check: hole edge at X = HOLE_CENTER_X + HOLE_RADIUS = 0 + 3 = 3 mm, leg inner face at LEG_INNER_FACE_X = 20 mm -> 17 mm clear, hole does NOT intersect the leg (special feature [4]). The leg sits at X = 20..25 so the +Y/-Y leg faces are untouched by the hole.
